method.primary: The original summary.json point estimates and within-window paired-block intervals are retained unchanged.
method.domain_cluster: For each lookup provider/contrast, sample ten observed domain labels with replacement. Each selected cluster retains all its measured repetitions and windows. Compute the pooled median paired difference. Report percentile 2.5/97.5 limits. Percentage intervals resample domain clusters separately with a distinct deterministic seed.
method.scope: Secondary conditional sensitivity only. Ten selected domains are few clusters and not a random domain population. Serial/time effects and unobserved cache differences remain. This alternative interval is not inherently more valid than the primary interval.
method.pages: No domain-cluster interval is computed for pages because the fixed hostname graph is a shared fixture, not independent domain-set replication.
method.sign: Fractions of complete successful matched blocks with positive, negative or exactly zero DoH-minus-UDP difference; descriptive only, not a sign test.
method.outliers: All valid observed values retained; no trimming, winsorization or imputation.
method.dates: Each date analyzed independently. No pooled-date effect estimate.
